name: The Satyrs of the Skola Valley
description: Satyrs of Theros for whom pleasure, revelry and mischief are virtues of the highest regard.

relations.note: He does not rule them but savors his role as de facto revelry host.
relations.quote: While he does not rule the satyrs, Xenagos savors his role as de facto revelry host.
